status: DESIGN executable content; source-linked and certification-neutral
source_policy: Every row names its owner, supporting sources, execution state, and deferred rules. The runtime never promotes this registry into canon.

entries.name: Obsidian Daggers
entries.rule_summary: +16, 1d8+10, thrown 30/70; bypasses damage-type resistance and has the declared force-construct lane.

action.visible_result: Doran's obsidian daggers are drawn and the next dagger lane is explicit.

entries.name: Giant Cleaver
entries.rule_summary: +16, fixed 40 damage or 80 on a critical, reach 10/5 ft; choked mode is +14 at 5 ft.

targeting.kind: one legal enemy; Grand Cleave has its own arc

action.visible_result: Doran's cleaver mode is selected; the runtime will quote its fixed damage and reach.

entries.name: Mirror-white Divine Plate
entries.rule_summary: Directional mitigation: net 1/4 piercing, 3/8 slashing, 3/4 bludgeoning under the source armor lane.

action.visible_result: The runtime keeps Doran's plate mitigation in the damage evidence.

entries.name: Helm
entries.rule_summary: Normal sight through magical and nonmagical darkness to 120 ft; no attunement and not truesight.

action.visible_result: Darkness remains legible to Doran within the source sight range.

entries.name: Gauntlet Shield Kite
entries.rule_summary: A forearm kite that costs no hand and opens a 4x3 barrier for half or three-quarters cover.

action.visible_result: The kite stance and cover are recorded by the combat runtime.

entries.name: Ring of Regeneration
entries.rule_summary: Bonus action, unlimited, 4d4 maximized to 16 HP; requires Doran to have at least 1 HP.

action.visible_result: The ring's maximized 16-point healing and spent bonus action are visible.

entries.name: Grand Cleave
entries.rule_summary: +19, 120+4d20 damage doubled on a critical; 15-ft 180-degree arc, capacity seven Medium targets, whole-turn commitment.

targeting.kind: all legal creatures in facing arc

action.visible_result: Every reached creature, critical multiplier, and structure cut is returned as evidence.

entries.name: Read the Seam
entries.rule_summary: Bonus-action Insight +16 against target AC; success creates a 16-20 critical window until that target hits Doran.

cost.cooldown: one target window at a time

action.visible_result: The Insight roll and any critical window are returned; a target hit closes it.

entries.name: Black Bird Sigil
entries.rule_summary: +5 INT/WIS saves, a 75-point ward, +1 spell DC/attack, and the declared force lane.

action.visible_result: Wren's ward, save lane, and spell modifiers remain visible in runtime evidence.

entries.name: Ring of Concentration
entries.rule_summary: One independent long-rest concentration spell; the source default is haste on Doran with no damage or duration checks.

action.visible_result: The independent concentration lane and its source default are inspectable without inventing a spell.

entries.name: Robe of the Archmagi
entries.rule_summary: AC 15+DEX when unarmored, +2 spell DC/attack, advantage against spells and magical effects, six robe stars and permanent Crown of Stars.

action.visible_result: The robe's AC, saves, stars, and permanent crown are represented in the returned sheet and combat state.

entries.name: Staff of the Magi
entries.rule_summary: Indestructible 50-charge staff; reaction spell absorption, 4d6+2 daily recovery, deliberate 16d6 retributive strike, and physical utility.

deferred: physical interposition beyond the explicit prop/jam/lever/span utility modes remains table adjudication

targeting.kind: incoming spell targeting Wren, utility object, or hostile target

action.visible_result: Absorption, utility, charges, or deliberate destruction are returned as explicit results.

entries.name: Crown of Stars
entries.rule_summary: Permanently active seven-mote crown; bonus action launches +14, 4d12 radiant and spends a mote on hit or miss.

action.visible_result: The attack roll, radiant damage, and mote spent are visible even on a miss.

entries.name: Staff Spell Absorption
entries.rule_summary: Reaction only when an enemy spell targets Wren; absorbs up to the declared staff capacity and adds the level to charges.

action.visible_result: The pending spell window closes and the absorbed level and charge change are recorded.

entries.name: Staff Retributive Strike
entries.rule_summary: Deliberate destruction of the staff for 16d6 force in a 30-ft hostile lane.

action.visible_result: The force rolls, targets, and irreversible staff destruction are recorded.

entries.name: Portal Shear
entries.rule_summary: One planted full-turn force line, 50 ft (100 ft with Distant), CON DC 22, 8d20 on a failed save; threshold death uses flat CON 25.

targeting.kind: every crossed creature, object, structure, or terrain

action.visible_result: The line geometry, each save, damage, and threshold death check are returned; no guessed Portal Slash behavior is substituted.

entries.name: Niv's Descent
entries.rule_summary: Intentional full-turn dive; DEX DC 22 control shockwave at 20 ft and CON DC 22 8d6 elemental wave at 30 ft.

targeting.kind: all other actors in the two lanes

action.visible_result: Both save lanes, rolls, healing, damage, and rough-terrain consequences are returned.

entries.name: Dimensional Shift
entries.rule_summary: Action; Wren plus six willing creatures within 30 ft to a visible or recently stood point; costs Channel Divinity.

action.visible_result: The destination, each toll save, and each moved actor are returned.

entries.name: Portal 14 — Unbarred
entries.rule_summary: Wren's teleportation cannot be stopped by dimensional lock, forcecage, anti-teleport wards, or effects of 8th level or lower; five free Misty Steps per long rest.

action.visible_result: The runtime shows the free teleport and its remaining pool.

entries.name: The Open Door
entries.rule_summary: Reaction return for Wren and willing allies within 30 ft to a long-rest anchor; the 60-ft toll forces CHA saves on teleport entry or exit.

action.visible_result: The anchor destination, toll saves, and carried allies remain explicit.

entries.name: Indomitable Spirit
entries.rule_summary: Action and Channel Divinity: end and block the listed coercive conditions for Wren and allies within 30 ft for one minute.

action.visible_result: Cleared conditions and the ten-round protection window are returned.

entries.name: Unshackled Host
entries.rule_summary: Thirty-foot non-concentration freedom-of-movement aura; an ally at zero HP can move at full speed without provoking as a reaction.

action.visible_result: Grapple/restraint denial and any zero-HP movement event are visible in state evidence.

entries.name: Aura of the Unbound
entries.rule_summary: Thirty-foot ally aura; once per long rest, reaction converts an ally's failed save, including save-or-die, into a success.

targeting.kind: one willing ally with persisted failed save

action.visible_result: The failed-save receipt and the conversion are both retained.

entries.name: Simulacrum
entries.rule_summary: Full-turn creation of an independent Wren copy with halved HP, spell slots, and sorcery points; global active copy cap four.

action.visible_result: The new copy, generation, initiative, HP, and halved resources are returned.

entries.name: Metamagic
entries.rule_summary: One metamagic costs sorcery points; two add a bonus-action tax; three or more consume the entire turn. Quicken costs four and is exclusive.

action.visible_result: Modifier list, SP cost, and action-economy tax appear beside the spell resolution.

entries.name: Gate
entries.rule_summary: Ninth-level concentration gate; the destination plane and optional named creature are required inputs.

targeting.kind: named plane and optional named creature

action.visible_result: The portal record includes plane, named pull, and concentration; a missing plane asks for clarification.

entries.name: Portal Slash
entries.rule_summary: Specified separate DEX DC 22 whip-arc lane, but not acquired and not a runtime option.

deferred: specified, not acquired, not a runtime option; narrative unlock has no mechanical trigger

entries.name: Imprisonment
entries.rule_summary: The source carries a sealed long-rest resource, but the spell's live execution ruling is unresolved.

action.visible_result: The failed save creates explicit spatial containment; a successful save does not.

entries.name: Ambush
entries.rule_summary: +1d12 to DEX (Stealth) or initiative; initiative declaration is a pre-roll timing lane.

deferred: initiative declaration before begin is not a live action window

action.visible_result: A pre-check maneuver remains visible and refuses if the timing window is unavailable.

entries.name: Bait and Switch
entries.rule_summary: Swap with a willing adjacent creature while moving and add d12 AC to one participant.

action.visible_result: The swap, movement cost, die, and AC beneficiary are returned.

entries.name: Brace
entries.rule_summary: Reaction melee attack when a creature enters reach, adding d12 damage.

action.visible_result: The brace reaction and superiority die are visible in the reaction receipt.

entries.name: Commander's Strike
entries.rule_summary: Forgo one attack and bonus action so an ally makes a reaction weapon attack with +d12 damage.

action.visible_result: The attack forfeiture and pending ally reaction are returned.

entries.name: Commanding Presence
entries.rule_summary: +1d12 to Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion.

action.visible_result: The skill, die, and resulting check are returned.

entries.name: Disarming Attack
entries.rule_summary: +d12 damage; STR DC 22 or target drops one held object.

action.visible_result: Attack, superiority damage, save, and disarmed state are returned.

entries.name: Distracting Strike
entries.rule_summary: +d12 damage; another attack gains advantage before Doran's next turn.

action.visible_result: The hit and next-attacker advantage marker are returned.

entries.name: Evasive Footwork
entries.rule_summary: +d12 AC while moving is rejected by the settled Doran AC lock; the refusal is executable and spends no die.

action.visible_result: The source conflict is reported without spending a superiority die.

entries.name: Feinting Attack
entries.rule_summary: Bonus action for advantage on the next adjacent attack and +d12 damage on hit.

action.visible_result: The feint marker and follow-up attack evidence are returned.

entries.name: Goading Attack
entries.rule_summary: +d12 damage; WIS DC 22 or disadvantage attacking anyone except Doran.

action.visible_result: The WIS save and any goaded-by-Doran rule are returned.

entries.name: Grappling Strike
entries.rule_summary: After a hit, bonus-action grapple with +d12 Athletics check.

action.visible_result: The preceding-hit receipt, Athletics check, and grapple result are returned.

entries.name: Lunging Attack
entries.rule_summary: +5 ft melee reach and +d12 damage on hit.

action.visible_result: The extended reach and superiority damage are explicit.

entries.name: Maneuvering Attack
entries.rule_summary: +d12 damage; an ally uses its reaction to move half speed without provoking from the target.

action.visible_result: The ally movement, reaction cost, and no-provoke marker are returned.

entries.name: Menacing Attack
entries.rule_summary: +d12 damage; WIS DC 22 or frightened until the end of Doran's next turn.

action.visible_result: The WIS save and frightened condition are returned.

entries.name: Parry
entries.rule_summary: Reaction to reduce melee damage by 1d12+3 under the current DEX modifier lane.

action.visible_result: The actual incoming-hit window, defense roll, damage reduction, reaction, and superiority die are returned.

entries.name: Precision Attack
entries.rule_summary: +d12 to an attack roll before its outcome.

action.visible_result: The precision die and final attack total are returned.

entries.name: Pushing Attack
entries.rule_summary: +d12 damage; STR DC 22 or push a legally grapple-able target up to 15 ft.

action.visible_result: The save and exact pushed position are returned.

entries.name: Quick Toss
entries.rule_summary: Bonus-action thrown-weapon attack with +d12 damage.

action.visible_result: The bonus attack and superiority damage are returned.

entries.name: Rally
entries.rule_summary: Bonus action; an ally gains 1d12+3 temporary HP.

action.visible_result: Temporary HP and its die are returned.

entries.name: Riposte
entries.rule_summary: Reaction melee attack when a creature misses Doran, adding d12 damage.

action.visible_result: The actual miss window, reaction attack, bonus damage, reaction, and superiority die are returned.

entries.name: Sweeping Attack
entries.rule_summary: On a melee hit, carry d12 damage into a second adjacent creature if the original roll also reaches its AC.

action.visible_result: Both target results and the transferred die are returned.

entries.name: Tactical Assessment
entries.rule_summary: +1d12 to Investigation, History, or Insight.

action.visible_result: The skill, die, and check total are returned.

entries.name: Trip Attack
entries.rule_summary: +d12 damage; STR DC 22 or a legally grapple-able target falls prone.

action.visible_result: The save and prone outcome are returned.

rooms.atmosphere: The market keeps its voice low around the well; copper clasps flash whenever the residents close ranks.

tells.text: The same copper clasp catches every turn of the light before the crowd moves.

objects.name: old waterwheel
objects.inspect_text: The wheel's dry spokes still point toward a release below the market.

hook.text: A hidden route is marked in the dust beneath the wheel.

hooks.text: The well route can be opened from the market's old waterwheel.

rooms.atmosphere: Conveyor teeth turn behind the walls, and steam writes brief white warnings across the gantries.

tells.text: A blue cable links the cleaners' armor to a relay that never moves.

objects.name: blue relay
objects.inspect_text: The stationary relay is the source of the cleaners' surge; its breaker is reachable from the service side.

hook.text: The relay can be cut before the next surge.

hooks.text: The blue cable exposes a cut-power counterplay.

rooms.atmosphere: Three painted territories share one gallery, each hoard passage guarded by a different color of scale.

tells.text: Painted scales on the supply crates identify which territory supplied each guard.

objects.name: neutral tunnel map
objects.inspect_text: The neutral tunnel avoids the nursery and reaches the lower route without crossing a marked hoard.

hook.text: The map offers a route that does not trespass on any nursery.

hooks.text: A neutral tunnel offers counterplay to the faction node.

rooms.atmosphere: The water moves below the wrecks without a tide; salt handprints appear above the waterline and then vanish.

tells.text: Salt dries in handprints above the waterline before anything surfaces.

objects.name: submerged bell
objects.inspect_text: The bell's chain runs beneath a dry plank and marks a passage under the wrecks.

hook.text: A lighted bell route is possible beneath the wrecks.

hooks.text: The bell marks a dry passage under the wrecks.

rooms.atmosphere: The palace floor shines beneath five rival positions; a central cocoon brightens one seam at a time.

tells.text: One seam in the cocoon brightens with each passing round.

objects.name: extraction stair
objects.inspect_text: A service stair reaches the extraction balcony without crossing the central platform.

hook.text: The stair preserves an authored extraction route.

hooks.text: The service stair reaches the extraction balcony.
